sections.title: Comment
sections.body:
##   CodeAnt Nitpicks
2 code suggestions #### 1. Each failure restarts the 15-minute expiry, so attempts spaced less than 15 minutes apart can accumulate over a much longer period and trigger the threshold incorrectly. Logic error · [`app/Services/AuthenticationService.php:25`](https://github.com/Bizionic-Tech/earnon/pull/113/files#diff-78e0a5e3303f705d74ecacf205e82b4171504f5aaeb7caab7c554e22e14f28f8R25-R25) --- #### 2. With the default MySQL case-insensitive collation, differently cased emails identify the same account, but this key splits their failures and lets attempts evade the threshold. Security · [`app/Services/AuthenticationService.php:52`](https://github.com/Bizionic-Tech/earnon/pull/113/files#diff-78e0a5e3303f705d74ecacf205e82b4171504f5aaeb7caab7c554e22e14f28f8R52-R52)
---
2 custom suggestions #### 1. Move the reCAPTCHA annotation and after-response dispatch into an application service, leaving the controller to invoke that service; this also avoids duplicating the annotation workflow performed by the 2FA controller. Custom_rule · [`app/Http/Controllers/Api/AuthController.php:498-506`](https://github.com/Bizionic-Tech/earnon/pull/113/files#diff-ad6f5ce68221913af0e24dc74b618133cc1f3d1637f388a6bb3f9fe5f31947e0R498-R506) --- #### 2. Pass the validated account identifier into the service and avoid reading email or username directly from the HTTP request. Custom_rule · [`app/Services/CaptchaService.php:398`](https://github.com/Bizionic-Tech/earnon/pull/113/files#diff-1c2ff23ea8a6a9281dd728c5b55dc0bec2c820f0bf1d62bcaf0f641f31427307R398-R398)
